add.event: 迪拜统治者批准法令设立迪拜世界
add.evidence: Dubai World was established under a decree ratified on 2 March 2006 by Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Ruler of Dubai.

add.event: 阿布扎比向迪拜政府提供100亿美元援助，其中41亿美元用于偿还Nakheel伊斯兰债券
add.evidence: On 14 December 2009 the Dubai government received $10 billion in surprise aid from Abu Dhabi for debt-laden Dubai World, which said it would use $4.1 billion of it to repay its Nakheel unit's Islamic bond

add.event: 迪拜世界与多数银行债权人就重组235亿美元债务达成原则性协议
add.evidence: Dubai World on 20 May 2010 said that it had reached an agreement "in principle" with most of its bank lenders to restructure debt worth $23.5bn
